answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a mesa bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the pigment schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
